en: Color-tinted historical postcard view of a railway station building with multiple tracks in the foreground. The two‑story masonry station has a gabled roof and a covered platform. Several railway staff and people stand in front of the building. At the top in red letters is the title identifying the station as Waldenburg in Saxony. A station sign reading "Waldenburg" is visible on the platform. The style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century German postcard.
